family_dispositions.rationale: Only attachment effects on governed create/comment paths are reviewed.
Existing governed issue behavior must remain compatible.
Only governed status behavior is admitted.
Governed project operations are required; root flags remain CLI control.
Local controls are not public SDK operations.
All governed operations preserve SDK error mapping.
Workspace repositories are not project resources.

operations.rationale: Existing inline comment add remains supported.
Cursor pair replaces the obsolete scalar cursor contract.
Existing create plus ordered label attachment is preserved.
Existing label relation add remains idempotent.
Existing label relation remove remains idempotent.
Existing filters plus reviewed sort/direction remain supported.
Only target issue status command is emitted.
Public name maps to target title.
Path and daemon are required; None or blank label is omitted.
Only a nonblank local path is public; daemon and label are preserved internally and cannot be cleared.
Only target project status command is emitted.
Unset omits, empty clears, None rejects, and an all-omitted request rejects.
